heading: **15 June 2026**
body:
**Repeated library prep for C3, C4 NCAP & HTS samples**

*PE Phusion Mix (16X)*

| PE Phusion Mix |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 16 plates |
| MQ water | 2.39642μL | 1055.25 μL | 16884 μL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 2.47818μL | 1091.25 μL | 17460 μL |
| 10mM dNTP | 0.48542μL | 213.75 μL | 3420 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.49819μL | 219.375 μL | 3510 μL |
| HF Phusion DNA Pol (2U/µL) | 0.14179μL | 62.4375 μL | 999 μL |
| Total | 6μL | 2642.0625 μL | 42.273 mL |

Add 10 uL of 100 uM PE\_F primer per 1 mL of primer mix i.e. to the total mix we add 422.8 uL of 100 uM PE\_F primer.
title: Repeated library prep for C3, C4 NCAP & HTS samples
